warnings.detail: No model weights, actual differentiable component path, image run, GPU-fit result or latent-to-DCT feasibility measurement is supplied; the bridge is a falsifiable design.
No final parameter/threshold configuration or validation-manifest receipt exists; A4 calibration, sample size, controls and stop rules remain pending.
The selected model repository is an unaffiliated mirror; exact component bytes, original-weight equivalence, acquisition terms and tokenizer constituent hashes require verification before execution.
RGB8 input policy can reject some final-source images; dataset inventory must count every unsupported item and a reviewed resolution is needed before claiming full coverage.
Cross-runtime CLIP preprocessing, ICC conversion, JSON numeric canonicalization, DCT, SHAKE/Box-Muller and PNG rounding parity require implementation vectors and environment locks.
Public OwnerID permits unauthorized re-embedding; neither component mismatch nor a positive score proves legal ownership, regeneration or transfer.
The repository's audit_evidence.py helper is absent, so this documentary review was manual; automated evidence-helper success is not claimed.
